stop_contract.expected_admin_stop: ExecStop writes a request bound to the current activation token and PID before signaling; repeated requests are idempotent.
stop_contract.cooperative_exit: The frozen Guard remains unchanged. On expected stop, at most one unfinished reservation becomes INTERRUPTED, retaining its attempt budget; completed results are never overwritten.
stop_contract.checkpoint_validation: Both SQLite integrity/foreign-key checks pass, COMPLETE attempts bijectively match evaluations, last checkpoint identifies an atomic completed row, no open reservations remain, count never decreases, original identity and OOS barrier remain valid.
stop_contract.unexpected_signal: SIGTERM without a bound administrative request is FAILED, including signals during unsaved work. No generic CalledProcessError is reclassified.
stop_contract.hard_timeout: Only systemd ExecStopPost with SERVICE_RESULT=timeout and an existing activation record may reconcile at most one abandoned reservation and validate the last durable checkpoint. Systemd remains failed/timeout; database may become CHECKPOINTED and Restart=on-failure resumes. Invalid database/checkpoint becomes FAILED.
stop_contract.failure_history: Record original failure and authorized recovery event transactionally before clearing only current runtime failure; preserve all previous events.

migration.single_host: Disable Pi research dispatch/maintenance/broker only after valid checkpoint; acquire worker and broker locks for SQLite-safe package; never run real experiment workers on both hosts.
migration.engine: Exact frozen release and input hashes; no scientific code or budget change. VPS uses frozen Guard with pi=false plus external OS resource isolation; Pi retains frozen production gate and limits.
migration.validation_resume: Bounded evaluation-count guard and no_outer stop before outer_estimate; no new experiment initialization.
migration.cross_architecture: Exact signal decisions, event identities, integer/string fields, nonfinite masks and shapes. Numeric replay uses the frozen evaluator.prefix_audit existing rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-10, declared before replay, for fills/daily returns/NAV/metrics. Fixed existing candidate, development slice, search seed and double_cost stress; report exact equality separately. No tolerance adjustment after results.
migration.vps_limits: One network-denied worker; MemoryMax=4608M MemorySwapMax=0 CPUQuota=300% CPUWeight=10 Nice=10 TasksMax=32; isolated development-only broker limited to 512M/20% CPU with root-owned systemd credential. Research logs rotate daily, 7 compressed copies, 10M maximum size; backup health records disk usage and warning above 75%.
migration.backup: Worker/broker locks; SQLite backup API; manifest SHA256; 7 daily and 4 weekly snapshots. Export read-only, no production writes. Never delete newest valid backup, manifest or final result.
